question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom Phrase.

To see the light
solution:
The correct answer is "**suddenly realize or understand something.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An Idiom is an expression whose meaning is different from the meanings of the individual words in it.
 
 
• Example: A piece of cake: something very easy to do/achieve.
 
 
 
• Now, in the given question,
 
• **"To see the light" means to have a sudden realization or understanding about something. **(किसी चीज़ के बारे में अचानक अहसास या समझ होना।)
 
• **It can also mean to finally understand or appreciate something after a period of confusion or ignorance.**
 
 
• Example: After struggling with the math problem for hours, I finally saw the light and was able to solve it.
 
 
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the correct meaning of the given sentence is given in option 4.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: To gain conscious - This phrase means to regain consciousness after being unconscious or asleep.
 
• Option 2: To misunderstand the situation - This means to have an incorrect or incomplete understanding of a situation.
 
• Option 3: To be optimistic - This means to have a positive outlook or hope for the future.
